'''Wunda''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who resided and owned several businesses in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] around the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Wunda visited the [[Thirsty Bantha]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] owned by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Robb]]. While at the cantina, Wunda unknowingly helped the bartender avoid the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] loan shark [[Varak'Cha]] who, in turn, owed the Hutt a large amount of credits.<ref name="Cantina" />

Wunda the Hutt was known for frequenting cantinas, and demanding a seemingly endless stream of foods and drinks. Wunda had little patience and a short temper, throwing fits of rage when not pleased. He possessed a customized [[Hoversled/Legends|hoversled]] designed to fit through the narrow corridors of traditional cantinas. Wunda was often escorted by his [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] bodyguards. [[Mogrugg]], one of Wunda's many guards, loyally served the Hutt for years.<ref name="Cantina" />
